fusions.name: Same Spot Again
fusions.desc: Bites the spot the last bite opened, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Frenzy
fusions.desc: Rats fan out in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Second Run-Through
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Maze-Bred
fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold your abilities come round 5% sooner.
